title: Single Day (Advanced)
description: Choose a route and enter the date of an incident. Compare against the next week and the year. Three per-segment grids carry the queue growth.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210482. PARTIAL fix found live: the 6 derived comps correctly carried real dateFormula/derivedFromRoute, but pointed at 'Incident Day' itself (a sibling comp), which in turn was still a frozen literal (Aug 5, 2024) with no formula at all — the base itself was never repointed to __TODAY__, contradicting the archive's own documented design ('Incident Day + its 6 derived comps, all repointed straight at __TODAY__ instead of chaining through Incident Day'). Fixed for real here: Incident Day now derives from __TODAY__ (startDate=>day+0day->1day, so the viewer picks the actual date via the entry gate's 'Viewing as of' field, defaulting to today) and all 6 formerly-Incident-Day-derived comps repointed to derive from __TODAY__ directly (single-hop rule) — same formula strings, since 'N days/weeks/months after Incident Day' and 'N days/weeks/months after Today' are the same computation once Incident Day IS Today by default. One graph (bar_delay) had an orphaned routeId (comp-12, not in the live route array) and was re-pointed at the Current Year comp per its own title.
